title: Aminess Hotels & Resorts - Videos
description:
Aminess Hotels & Resorts is a fast-growing tourism brand, built on a particularly friendly attitude towards guests and employees. Its very name is an amalgamation of the French word Ami, meaning “friend”, and a suffix representing our core values: friendliness, kindness, happiness.

The Aminess brand includes high-category hotels, campsites and villas, located in Novigrad (Istria), Krk, Novi Vinodolski, Crikvenica, Makarska, island of Pag, Korčula and Pelješac. There is a total of 14 hotels, 5 campsites and 3 resorts with villas and apartments.

Drawing on 40 years of guest experiences, we've built a chain where you can find your perfect holiday anytime. Enjoy modern wellness, sports, exciting entertainment, and gourmet dining. Just choose your holiday style.

And we will make sure you never forget it.
Aminess Hotels: https://www.aminess.com/en/
